description_en: Creates a data report export task
description_zh: 创建数据报表导出任务
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-ecd-report-task --business-channel example-string --task-type RESOURCE_REPORT --sub-type DESKTOP --filter-list '[{"FilterValues":["测试云电脑名称"],"FilterKey":"Tag:TestKey"}]' --report-file-name Test_report_name --lang-type zh-CN --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEcdReportTask

parameters.help_zh:
业务渠道, 取值：
Enterprise：企业版
Business：商业版
parameters.name: business_channel

parameters.help_en:
The report task subtype.
[_single.params.SubType.enum.  DESKTOP]Cloud computer
parameters.name: sub_type

element_fields.help_en:
The report query filter condition. The valid values vary based on the SubType value:
Cloud computer report
KeyWord: automatic keyword recognition for cloud computers.
RegionId: the region ID.
DesktopId: the cloud computer ID.
DesktopName: the cloud computer name (fuzzy match).
OfficeSiteId: the office network ID.
OfficeSiteName: the office network name (fuzzy match).
Status: the cloud computer status.
DesktopType: the desktop specifications.
DesktopIP: the cloud computer IP address.
SubPayType: the billing method.
EndUserId: the username (fuzzy match).
ExpireTime: the expiration time in the yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z' format.
IncludeAssignedUser: specifies whether users are assigned.
ResourceGroupId: the resource group ID.
PolicyId: the policy ID.
Tag:{Tag key}: the cloud computer tag. To query by multiple tags, pass in multiple Filter objects
element_fields.help_zh:
报表查询过滤条件，根据SubType不同：
云电脑报表
KeyWord  云电脑关键字自动识别
RegionId  地域ID
DesktopId  云电脑ID
DesktopName  云电脑名称（模糊搜索）
OfficeSiteId  办公网络ID
OfficeSiteName  办公网络名称（模糊搜索）
Status  云电脑状态
DesktopType  桌面规格
DesktopIP  云电脑IP
SubPayType  购买方式
EndUserId  用户名称（模糊搜索）
ExpireTime  过期时间，格式为yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss'Z'
IncludeAssignedUser  是否分配用户
ResourceGroupId  资源组ID
PolicyId  策略ID
Tag:{标签Key值}  云电脑标签（多标签查询时，传入多个Filter对象）
element_fields.name: filter_key

element_fields.help_en:
The values of the filter condition.
When FilterKey is set to one of the following values, only the first value in FilterValues is used:
KeyWord
DesktopName
OfficeSiteName
DesktopIP
EndUserId
ExpireTime
IncludeAssignedUser
element_fields.help_zh:
过滤条件的值。
当FilterKey是以下取值时，FIlterValues入参只取第一个值：
KeyWord
DesktopName
OfficeSiteName
DesktopIP
EndUserId
ExpireTime
IncludeAssignedUser
element_fields.name: filter_values

parameters.help_en:
The list of filter conditions for query results. The filter condition objects have a logical AND (&) relationship.
Each filter condition contains FilterKey and FilterValues, which represent the filter condition name and specific values
parameters.help_zh:
查询结果过滤条件列表，各个查询条件对象是“逻辑与”关系（&）。
每个查询条件包含FilterKey、FilterValues，表示查询条件名称和具体取值
